scope: Actual browser/HTTP/encrypted settings using saved fictional observations and a reconstructed legacy custom-account collision. No new OCR/classification inference.
checks: QA launcher refuses the default ledger path and cached data/port mismatches before creating a key or database
keyboard/mouse stars add and remove without receipt changes or dirty drafts; shortcuts synchronize category/account and the native two-layer selector remains intact
favorites persist through a real browser reload
a failed favorite POST shows an error, retains the existing star and shortcut, and succeeds on retry
detail shortcuts preserve unsaved amount/purpose, star-only actions never dirty a receipt, and delayed favorite responses do not steal focus
historical custom name E129 and formal code E129 retain separate stable-code stars and correct category/account shortcuts
catalog exposes stars only for selectable expense/asset accounts and its changes synchronize with the picker
all favorites including a long custom name fit desktop and375px dialog widths; selecting a wrapped shortcut works without changing saved receipts, versions, statuses, postings or audit history
after stopping the QA server a separate Python process reopens the encrypted DB with all favorites and unchanged schema; unkeyed SQLite cannot read settings
